name: is101-personal-website
description: IS101 Personal Website Project — WordPress theme, Excel GPT plugin, and an offline preview. There are no Node dependencies; these scripts are thin wrappers over the Python tooling in build/.

scripts.package: rm -f build/roman-heuser.zip build/rh-excel-gpt.zip && (cd theme && zip -rq ../build/roman-heuser.zip roman-heuser -x '.*' -x '*/.DS_Store') && (cd chatbot && zip -rq ../build/rh-excel-gpt.zip rh-excel-gpt -x '.*' -x '*/.DS_Store') && ls -lh build/*.zip
scripts.check: python3 build/phpcheck.py theme/roman-heuser/*.php theme/roman-heuser/inc/*.php chatbot/rh-excel-gpt/*.php && node --check theme/roman-heuser/assets/js/cinematic.js && node --check theme/roman-heuser/assets/js/theme.js && node --check chatbot/rh-excel-gpt/assets/rhxg.js && node --check preview/assets/blog-demo.js
